tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bstan bcos chen po sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam par bshad pa thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me las skabs gsum pa'i rnam par bshad pa bzhugs
༄༅/ /bstan bcos chen po sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam par bshad pa thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me las skabs gsum pa'i rnam par bshad pa bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bstan bcos chen po sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam par bshad pa thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me las skabs gsum pa'i rnam par bshad pa bzhugs so/ /gsum pa sngags kyi sdom pa'i nyams len ni/ lus rnam gzhag tu/ gsang sngags kyi ni dbang bskur dang / /de dag gi ni cho ga dang / /zhes sogs la 'phros nas/ sngags sdom gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par 'chad par byed pa la/ skabs gsum pa'i gzhung rnams byung / 'di la spyi'i don dang / gzhung gi don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gsung rab dgongs gsal na rgyas par bzhugs so/ /gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam/ zhes sogs rkang pa gsum ste/ skal dman rim 'jug pa ltar na/ so thar dang / byang sdom gnyis kyi sbyang pa sngon du song nas/ nye lam rdo rje theg pa'i lam du zhugs te/ myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod na smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam gnyis la 'bad par bya dgos te/ de gnyis rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te/ mtshan brjod kyi phan yon las/ byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi bshad pa spyod pa rnams kyis myur du 'grub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skal ldan cig car ba ltar na/ thun mong gi sdom pa gnyis kyi sbyang pa sngon du song ba la ma bltos par dang po nyid nas rdo rje theg pa'i sogs rtags chos 'dra'o/ /skal dman rim 'jug pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ skal dman sems can gdul dka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa nas/ 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ skal ldan cig car ba ni/ skal ldan sems can gdul sla ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ dang por kyai rdo rje bstan/

/zhes sogs don gyi thob par gsung pas 'grub bo/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ smin byed nor pa med pa'i dbang bzhi/ grol byed 'khrul pa med pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po/ phyag chen gon pa las 'khor 'das bsre ba'i spyod pa spyad pa/ de la brten nas sa lam bgrod de 'bras bu sngon du byed pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ma 'khrul ba'i smin byed bsgrub par gdam pa/ 'khrul pa'i smin byed dor bar gdams pa/ dbang las thob pa'i dam tshig la 'khrul pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ smin par byed pa'i/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ smin grol gnyis la 'bad par bya/ zhes pa la 'phros nas/ spyir rgyud sde bzhi la smin grol gnyis gsungs kyang / 'dir bla med kyi dbang du byas pa'i smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba yang / rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing dbang gi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur pa dang / phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel zab mo sgrig mkhyen cing / slob ma'i phung khams skye mched la sku bzhi'i sa bon theb par nus pa/ mdor na mdzad spyod thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin du mdzad pa yi bla ma dam pa 'bad pas rtsal la dbang bzhi blang bar bya ste/ dbang bzhi blang pa de yi rten gyi gang zag de rgyud sdom pa gsum ldan du gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhung 'dis/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ gsang sngags rgyal po rab tu bsgrub/ /sdom pa gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rigs 'dzin rang gi ngo bo 'o/ /zhes gsung pas ltar/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga las sdom pa gsum thob pa dngos su bstan pa yin la/ spyir sdom pa gsum len pa'i rim pa bdun yod de/ dang por nyan thos lugs kyi so thar rigs bdun gang rung blang / de nas dbu sems gang rung gi cho gas byang sdom blang /

de nas dbang chog las sngags sdom blang pa'i tshul dang / dang por theg chen so thar rigs bdun gang rung blang / de nas sdom pa gong ma gnyis rim gyis blang ba'i tshul dang / dang por nyan thos so thar gang yang rung ba blang / de nas sdom pa bar ma ma blang par/ dbang chog las sngags sdom blang pa'i tshul dang / dang por theg chen so thar gang yang rung ba blang / de nas sdom pa bar ma ma blang par/ dbang chog las sngags sdom blang pa'i tshul dang / dang por so thar gang rung sngon du ma song bar lugs gnyis gang rung gi cho gas byang sdom blang / de nas dbang chog las sngags sdom blang pa'i tshul dang / dang po nyid ni sdom pa 'og ma gnyis gang yang sngon du ma song bar dbang chog las sngags sdom blang pa'i tshul dang / dang por dbang chog las sngags sdom blang nas/ de'i rjes su sdom pa 'og ma gnyis blang pa'i tshul rnams so/ /'o na len tshul de ltar yin na/ rgyud la ldan tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ len tshul phyi ma gnyis la thams cad sngags sdom dang ngo bo cig pa'i tshul du ldan pa yin gyi/ gnas gyur rtsir med de/ dang po ni/ dbang chog gcig nyid las sdom pa gsum char thob pa yin pa dang / phyi ma ni/ sngags sdom dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis sdom pa gang blang kyang sngags sdom kyi ngo bor skye ba tsam yod pa'i phyir/ len tshul dang po lnga ni/ gnas gyur ngo bo cig pa'i tshul du ldan pa yin no/ /sdom pa gsum gyi ldan tshul la rgya bod kyi mkhas pa'i bzhed pa mang na yang / gnas gyur dang po gcig tu ldan pa 'di ni gsung rab kyi dgongs pa 'brel ba la 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad par spangs pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi bzhed pa bla na med pa yin te/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i zhal snga nas/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel par/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa de blang ba'i cho ga gzhan zhig yod dam/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa nyid yin zhe na/

sngar so so thar pa'i sdom pa thob na/ phyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob pa'i dus sngar gyi de byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par gnas 'gyur la/ sngar ma thob na ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon pa'i dus nyid du byang chub sems dpa'i so so thar pa'i sdom pa thob pa yin no/ /rnam par spros pas chog go /zhes pa dang / rtsa ltung 'khrul spongs las 'o na sngar so so thar pa'i sdom pa dge slong gi bar thob pa zhig gis phyis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas slar yang dbang nos par gyur na 'di la sdom pa ji ltar ldan zhe na/ dge slong gis sems bskyed pa'i tshe so so thar pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par 'gyur la/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i tshe na sdom pa thams cad kyang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de skad du rgyud 'bum pa'i lung de kho na nyid kyi ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba las byung ba/ rdo yi rigs kyi bye brag gis/ /bzhus pas lcags dang zangs dngul 'byung / /gser 'gyur rtsi yi dngos po yis/ /kun kyang gser du bsgyur bar byed/ /de bzhin sems kyi bye brag gis/ /rigs can gsum gyi sdom pa yang / /dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir bzhugs na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dpe de'i rdo ni 'phags pa yin la/ lcags ni nyan thos kyi bslab par bya ba/ zangs ni rang rgyal gyi bslab par bya ba/ dngul ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab par bya ba yin zhing / gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ni rdo rje theg pa'i bslab par bya ba yin par mngon no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rgyud 'bum pa'i lung 'di sdom gsum gnas gyur pa dang ngo bo gcig pa gnyis ka'i dpe don sbyor ba'i lung shin tu gces par gda' 'o/ /'di dag gi rnam gzhag kun mkhyen gyi sdom gsum spyi don gyi shog bu zhe lnga drug skor na rgyas par bzhugs shing / de dag la rigs pa'i mtha' dpyod bdag gis spyi don du rgyas par bkod pa rnams mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis legs par gzigs 'tshal lo//

༈ //dbang bzhi blangs/ /de yis sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes pa la mkhas pa kha cig shāka mchog gis/ dbang bzhi blang pas sdom pa gsum/ /thob par 'gyur na dge slong las/ /thob pa'i gsang sngags sdom pa dang / /dbang las thob pa'i so thar dang / /sems bskyed sdom pa cis mi bzhed/ /ces dris pa'i lan du kun mkhyen gyis de gsum car yang legs par bzhed de/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi le'u dang por/ sdom pa'i dbye ba bshad par bya ste zhes dang / phyi ma'i gsum par/ de nas rdo rje can gyi rnal 'byor ma rnams la rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi zhes bya ba'i thabs bka' stsal pa/ sdom pa dang ni dbang dang yang / /zhes dang / phyi ma'i bzhi par rnal 'byor ma lus dbus gnas su/ /a yi rnam pa sdom pa'i gnas/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu phye/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor gyi dang po'i gsum par/ kun la sna tshogs phyag rgyas te/ /kun la sna tshogs sdom pa yis/ /zhes dang / rgyud phyi mar/ 'di skad la sogs mtha' yas mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa mchog /ces pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /gal te 'di dag rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa yin gyi dbang las thob pa min no/ /snyam na/ lam gyi gnas skabs su sdom pa thob ces pa thams cad sngar thob zin gyi sdom pa yang yang gom pa yin pas de dag kyang dbang gi skabs su nges par thob dgos te/ gzhan du na/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam du thal ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi mar/ dri ba so gnyis pa/ de bzhin sdom pa ji lta bu/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ rdo rje can gyis der bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /bskyed pa yi ni rim nyid dang / /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'o/ /bsgrub pa dang ni nan tan dang / /dam tshig de bzhin sdom pa rnams/ /sngar bzhin de kun rgyas par ni/ /rim pa'i dbye bas phye ba yin/

/zhes gsungs pa 'dis/ sdom pa'i ngo bo bskyed rdzogs gnyis la mdzad pa dang / rgyud las gsung pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad kyang bskyed rdzogs gnyis su 'dus pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pas/ de lta bu'i rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa dang mchog dbang gong mar gsum las ma thob na bskyed rim gyi sdom pa de yang bum dbang las ma thob par rnam pa kun tu mtshungs pas rgyud las gsung pa'i sdom pa gang yang dbang las ma thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ji lta ba bzhin du bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ kyai/ rnam pa kun mchog sdom pa yis/ /bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor mi mdzad dam/ /rdzogs pa yang ni ji ltar lags/ /zhes sngags kyi sdom pa la bskyed rdzogs gnyis su phye nas/ de ji ltar zhes dris pa'i lan du/ rim par phye ba gnyis pas bskyed rim gyi sdom pa dang / gsum pas rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa gsal bar bstan pas/ don snga ma bzhin du gnas so/ /yang de nyid las/ bum pa las ni byung ba 'o/ /gnyis pa gsang ba mchog yin te/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes yin/ /bzhi pa de ltar yang de bzhin/ /dbang bskur 'di dag yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin dam tshig can zhes bya/ /zhes dbang bzhi rdzogs pas/ dam tshig rdzogs par bstan pa 'dis kyang / dbang gong ma la thob pa'i sngags kyi dam tshig gsal bar bstan to/ /de bzhin du ḍoṃ bhi ba'i lhan cig skyes grub las kyang / sdom pa gsum po re re la'ang phyi nang gnyis gnyis su phye nas/ sngags sdom gyi phyi'i sdom pa dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba dang / nang gi sdom pa shes pa snyung ma mi rtog pa la bshad pa dang / grub chen dman pa'i zhabs kyis/ sdom pa la spangs pa'i dam tshig sdom pa dang / bza' ba dang / bsrung ba'i dam tshig sdom pa dang / rnal 'byor snying po sdom pa gsum du phye ba'i nang gi sdom pa dang / rnal 'byor snying po sdom pa rnams dbang gong ma las thob pa'i gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'o/

/zhes gsung pa sogs rgyud dang / rgya gar gyi gzhung bzang de dag gi dgongs pa/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/ sdom pa gsum ldan gyi sngags sdom ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bzhi'i sdom pa thob pa'o/ /zhes dang / rje btsun rtse mos/ kha sbyor gyi 'grel par/ sdom pa zhes bya ba gong du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'ang gsum dngos su gsung / bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sdom pa'ang gsung nas/ der rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sdom pa de zhugs zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba la sogs pas de'i lan bstan te/ zhes dang / 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa la sbyar na/ gnas ni lus dang rtsa'i 'khor lo ste/ rang gi ngo bo la gsum las/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs sdom pa'i dbang du byas na/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad sdom pa'o/ /mang po gcig tu sdom pa'i dbang du byas na/ chos mthun gyi sgo nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'dir lus la bsdu ba'o/ /yang rang byung gi ye shes bde bas sdom pa'o/ /zhes dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ skyabs 'gro gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang yang ldan/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa byas te/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang yang ldan/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs te rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa dang yang ldan/ zhes gsung pa yin la/ de thams cad kyi don bsdus nas bstan bcos 'dir/ sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /bla ma stsal la dbang bzhi blang / /de yi sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes gsung pa yin pas/ dbang gong ma las thob pa'i sngags kyi sdom pa bzhed dam ci zhes ha cang thal ba'i dri ba ngom ngom mi dgos so/ /dbang las thob pa'i so thar dang byang sems legs par yang bzhed de/ sta gon dang 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi rgyun bshags las thun mong min pa'i so thar dang / smon 'jug gi sems bskyed thob pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/

/legs bshad 'dis ni bum dbang tsam gyi skabs su sngags sdom rdzogs par thob la/ dbang gong ma las dam tshig gsar thob yod kyi/ sngags sdom gsar thob med par 'dod pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa sdom pa mtshan nyid pa min par 'dod pa rnams la'ang shin tu gnod lags so/ /gnyis pa 'khrul pa'i smin byed dor bar gdam pa la bzhi ste/ smin byed min pa smin byed du 'dod pa dgag pa/ smin byed kyi dbang mi dgos par 'dod pa dgag pa/ dgos kyang 'khrul par spyod pa dgag pa/ dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ byin rlabs smin byed min pa dgag pa/ grangs nges med pa'i dbang bskur smin byed yin pa dgag pa/ dkyil 'khor ma dag pa'i dbang bskur smin byed yin pa dgag pa/ cho ga ma dag pa'i dbang bskur smin byed yin pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ phyogs snga ma brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ deng sang rdo rje zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ dus deng sang rdo rje phag mo yi byin rlabs kyi cho ga byed pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba yin zhes phyag rgya ba kha cig zer/ phag mo'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga 'di yis gsang sngags zab mo'i chos kyi sgo phye nas rlung dang gtum mo la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim zab mo ston pa dang / bsgom pa mthong / phag mo'i byin brlab kyis gsang sngags zab mo'i chos kyi sgo 'byed pa ni/ dwags po lha rje'i dus su byung ste/ bla ma gzhan la slob ma rnams dbang zhu ba la btang pas/ der bsdad nas phal cher log ma byung bas rang re tshang la yang dbang byed mkhan re dgos pa 'dug gsung pas/ kong ne ru pa na re/ ngas phag mo'i dbang re byas na zhus pas/ de chog gsungs nas phag mo'i byin rlabs re byas/ de nas bla mas/ na ro chos drug dang / phyag rgya chen po sogs bstan pas/ de nas bzung ste/ chos sgo ba la dbang zhus/ bla mas khrid gsungs pas/

bde mchog gi dbang ma thob kyang / rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam gyis chos drug gi chos sgo 'byed pa byung ngo / /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ byin rlabs smin byed yin pa la gnod byed bstan/ byin rlabs smin byed yin pa'i sgrub byed dgag byin rlabs chos sgor 'byed na ha cang thal ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ shes byed med pa/ nyes dmigs che ba/ phan yon med pa/ lung dang 'gal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di 'dra rgyud sde/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis te/ phag mo'i byin rlabs chos sgor byed pa mi 'thad de/ smin byed kyi dbang ma bskur bar phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam gyis chos kyi sgo phye nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa 'di 'dra ba/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud sde las ma gsungs shing / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos tshad ma rnams las bshad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ phag mo'i byin rlabs smin byed du 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ rdo rje phag mo'i gzhung khung ma nyid las kyang smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa de la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs bya zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhung khung ma gang khas blangs na/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i rdo rje phag mo nyid kyi gzhung / rje btsun ma rin chen rgyan gyi sgrub thabs las kyang / 'di ltar rnal 'byor dbang bskur ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas 'di dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ zhes dang / sngon gyi bla ma'i man ngag gi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa las de'i don la dmigs nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsam par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di 'grel byed phal cher gyis drangs par snang yang / rje btsun gyis/ rnal 'byor byang bzang gis dris lan las/ de'ang rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gzhung las/ byin rlabs phra mo bshad pa de dag gang zhe na/ dbang thob zin pa'i gang zag la/

ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par 'ga' zhig rgyud la skye bar bya ba'i phyir/ byin rlabs kyi rgyun bsgom du bzhugs pa zhes bya ba'i gdams ngag yin gyis/ dbang ma thob pa rnams la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba bstan du ga la rung / de'ang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rtsa ba lta bu/ rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa zhal gnyis chung ba zhes bya ba las/ sngags pas thog mar bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas la sems mngon par dad pa'i yid can gyis/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par bzung ste/ dbang bskur ba yang dag par thob nas zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes pa 'di nyid yin te/ lung 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rtsa ba lta bu zhes dang / rtsa bar rdo rje phag mo nyid las kyang / zhes gsungs pa ni don gcig go /rgyu mtshan des na/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur thob pa med pa la phag mo'i byin rlabs byed pa bkag ste/ dper na/ thog mar mu ze'i bcud len 'ju bar byas/ de nas dngul chu bza' bar gsung gi mu ze'i bcud len thog mar ma brten par dngul chu zos na za ba po 'chi ba de bzhin du/ thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur blangs/ de nas rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs sbyin par byed pa'i phyir dang / gzhan du smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba med par phag mo'i byin rlabs byas na/ byed pa po dam tshig gis nyams par thub pas gsungs pa'i phyir te/ yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i/ zhes sogs rkang pa drug ste/ rdo rje phag mo'i sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs byed pa 'di ni rdzogs rim gyi byin rlabs tsam yin gyi/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur min te/ smin byed kyi dbang yin na/ rgyud la sngar ma thob pa'i sdom pa gsum ldan du byed pa dang / phyi nang gi rten 'brel bsgrig pa dang /

sku bzhi'i sa bon theb nus pa gcig dgos pa las/ de lta bu'i phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ sngar ma thob pa'i sdom pa gsum ldan du byar mi rung zhing / phyi nang gi rten 'brel zab mo 'grig par mi 'gyur ba dang / phung khams skye mched la sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs par byed mi nus pa de'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ des na thub pas/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de lta bu'i byin rlabs smin byed kyi dbang ma thob pa la byed mi rung ste/ phag mo'i byin rlabs de rdzogs rim gyi byin rlabs tsam yin gyi smin byed min pa des na/ thub pas de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud sde las dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du gsang ba 'di ni ma smra zhig smras na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// ༈ //gzhung 'di dag la kha cig shāka mchog gis/ rdo rje phag mo 'ga' zhig las/ /dbang bzhi tshad ldan gzhung las bshad/ /de dag smin byed dbang bskur du/ /rung ngam mi rung gang yin dri/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ go bos/ de'i don ci zhig yin phag mo sngon byung gi rgyud las gsung pa'i rje btsun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga lta bu la zer ba yin na/ de ni smin byed du rung ste/ sangs rgyas ngos nas rdo rje phag mo la smin byed bla ma gong mas bkag pa ma yin gyi/ cho ga'i ngos nas byin rlabs smin byed yin pa bkag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma la yang / rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi le'u bcu pa las gsungs pa'i rje btsun gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga smin byed du bzhed kyang / bdag med ma'i byin rlabs smin byed du mi bzhed pa bzhin no/ /phan thogs par gyur cig ces gsungs// ༈ //yang dri ba/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ /sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang / /dkyil 'khor dang ni dbang bskur ba/ /rang lugs la yang mi bzhed dam/

/zhes pa'i lan ni/ kun mkhyen gyis sindhu ra yi dkyil 'khor du slob ma bcug nas byin rlabs la dbang bzhi'i tha snyad tsam zhig yod pa deng sang phyag len la yod pa 'di la zer ba yin na ni/ sngags sdom gsar du 'bogs pa'i cho ga min te/ sngags sdom thob zin pa la ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren du byin rlabs kyi cho ga tsam yin par rtsa ltung 'khrul spong dang / bstan bcos 'di gnyis char du gsal bar gsung bzhin du/ da dung dri na ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lag len gyi sgrub byed dgag pa/ rang bzo'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'ga' zhig 'di la'ang / zhes sogs rkang pa drug ste/ phyag rgya ba 'ga' zhig phag mo'i byin rlabs 'di la'ang phag mgo dang / gri gug dang / mda' gzhu dang / chang pa bstod pa la sogs pa'i dbang bskur ba yod ces zer/ byin rlabs de 'dra dbang bskur mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ dbang bskur ba yin na/ rgyud sde las gsungs dgos pa gang zhig rgyud sde snal ma kun las phag mgo la sogs pa'i dbang 'di 'dra ma gsung pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te rgya la rgyud sde 'ga' zhig las gsung pa srid kyang / de rjes gnang tsam yin gyi dbang bskur mtshan nyid pa ma yin te/ de la dbang gi mtshan nyid ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ la la rdo rje zhes sogs rkang pa bco brgyad de/ zhang tshang pa la sogs pa la la rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la/ smin byed yod par bsgrub 'dod nas sngags kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor dang ni dbang bskur la sogs pa rang bzo'i cho ga byed pa thos/ rang bzo byas pas cho gar 'gyur mi srid de/ cho ga mtshan nyid pa yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul te mdo rgyud nas gsung pa zhig yin dgos pa las/ khyod kyi cho ga de mdo rgyud gang nas kyang ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ dper na/ khyim pas mkhan slob dang / dad pa'i dge 'dun la sogs pa'i lad mo gsol gzhi'i las byas kyang /

bsgrub bya la dge slong gi sdom pa mi chags pa ltar/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la rang bzo'i dbang chog byas nas/ sdom pa phog kyang sdom pa 'chags par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rang bzo'i cho ga de mi 'thad de/ cho ga'i tshigs cung zad nyams pa ste lhag chad dang 'khrul pa la'ang cho ga ste/ sdom pa 'chags par ma gsung na/ sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga phal cher nyams pa la sdom pa'i cho ga 'chags par 'gyur re kan te mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ 'dul ba las/ bsgrub bya dang / mkhan po dang / dge 'dun gyi ming ma brjod na yang cho ga'i tshig zur nyams pas dge slong gi sdom pa mi skye bar gsung pa lta bu'o/ /rang bzo'i cho ga mi 'thad pa des na 'chad pa'i gnas skabs su/ tshig cung zad nor par gyur kyang sla yi/ dbang bskur ba dang / sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga cung zad nor par gyur pa la 'bras bu 'grub pa nam yang med par gsungs te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ khyad par can gyi las rnams la/ /lha dus bya ba dus bzhin spyad/ /gzhan du cho ga nyams pa'i phyir/ /'grub pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa byin rlabs chos sgor byed na ha cang thal ba ni/ gzhan yang phag mo'i/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gcig ste/ gzhan yang phag mo'i byin rlabs chos sgor byed na ha cang thal te/ phag mo'i byin rlabs la gsang sngags kyi chos sgor byed pa ni/ rgyud sde rnal ba gang na'ang bshad pa med pa'i phyir ro// ༈ //gzhung 'di la dri ba/ shāka byin rlabs chos sgor mi byed na/ /rdzogs rim 'ga' zhig nyan pa'i sar/ /byin rlabs nges par mdzad de ci/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ dwags po bka' rgyud pa dag gis/ /chos sgo'i don/ sngar smin byed ma thob kyang / byin rlabs de nyid byas pas na ro chos drug nyan cing sgom du rung bar 'dod la/ de 'dra'i chos sgo ni 'dir mi bzhed de/ gzhung 'di nyid du bkag pa'i lung rigs rnams bltas pas gsal lo/

/shin tu spros med/ dril bu rim lnga sogs rdzogs rim 'ga' zhig nyan pa'i sar byin rlabs nges par mdzad kyang / de sngar gyi chos sgo de dang gtan mi cig ste/ byin rlabs de nyid kyi sngon du smin byed 'gro dgos par bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang phag mo'i byin brlabs gsang sngags kyi chos sgor bshad pa med kyang byed pa de bas dge slong byed pa la/ rang byung gi ni bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / mthong lam gyi ye shes khong du chud pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / phrin gyi cho gas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas ston par khas blangs pas dang / tshur shog la tshangs par spyod cig ces pas dang / la sogs pa lci ba'i chos brgyad khas blangs pas dang / dris pa'i lan lon pas dang / dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su khas blangs pas dang / gsol gzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa blang bar rigs par 'gyur te/ phag mo'i byin rlabs gsang sngags kyi chos sgo smin byed dang / bsnyen rdzogs de dag da lta byed pa gnyis 'khrul pa yin pa snyam po la/ bsnyen rdzogs 'di rnams kyi thabs sngon sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus 'di rang mchan dang 'dres pa'i mchan snying zhig la snang ngo / gyi cho gar 'dul ba lung las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang lung las/ sangs rgyas dang rang sangs rgyas rang byung gi bsnyen rdzogs dang / lnga sde bzang po ye shes khong du chud pas dang / mchod bu mo chos sbyin zer ba'ang snang sbyin ma 'phrin gyis dang / 'od srung chen po ston par khas blangs pa dang / grags pa la sogs pa tshur shog dang / skye dgu'i bdag mo lci ba'i chos brgyad khas blang pas dang / bram ze mo ka ta ya na'i bu dris pa'i lan lon pas dang / bzang sde'i tshogs drug cu skyabs gsum khas blangs pas dang / gsol gzhi'i las kyis rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa rnams sngon gyi cho gar gsungs pa'i phyir ro//

༈ //gzhung 'di la dri ba/ shāka rang byung nas ni tshur shog bar/ /sngon chog yin par gang du bshad/ /ces pa'i lan ni/ go bo/ de dag bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa thob par byed pa'i cho ga khyad par can gang zhig da ltar gyi cho ga min pa la dgongs nas/ sngon chog tu bzhed pa yin la/ rgya che 'grel las/ mdo rtsa'i thog mar 'byung ba'i gsol ba dang gzhi'i las kyis cig char rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i cho ga kho na la sngon chog tu bshad pa ni/ lung gzhi'i rab byung gi gzhi'i skabs nas bshad pa'i cho ga la sngon chog dang / da ltar gyi cho ga gnyis su phye ba'i tshe/ 'di 'di la dogs dpyod bdag gi spyi don na bris par rtog go kho na sngon chog yin zhes pa'i don yin gyi sngon chog thams cad der nges pa ni min no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa grangs nges med pa'i dbang bskur smin byed yin pa dgag pa la bzhi ste/ grangs nges med pa gsang sngags nub pa'i dper bstan/ de nyid rgyud las bkag pa'i tshul/ rgyud de'i don bshad pa/ gzhan gyi dogs pa spangs ba'o/ /dang po ni/ des na nyan thos/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la ni da lta nub kyang gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang la/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ste/ phag mo'i byin rlabs gsang sngags kyi chos sgo dang / smin byed du ma bshad kyang byed pa des na ste de'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos kyi bstan pa gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang ste/ deng sang gang zag blun po snying phod can rnams kyis kyang / 'dul ba'i las kyi cho ga las rgal ma nus pa'i phyir/ dper na rab tu byung ba'i gang zag ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ tshogs kyi tshogs la las mi bya/ zhes pa la brten nas bsgrub bya gsum las mang ba las gral gcig tu 'jug mi nus pa bzhin no/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ste/

gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sogs thams cad la deng sang blun po rnams kyis rang bzor spyod pa mang ba'i phyir/ dper na gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa na/ slob ma grangs nges med par brgya stong sogs du ma la dbang bskur byed pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di ni rdo rje 'chang / zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gsum ste/ spyod rgyud ma yin pa'i gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur ba'i skabs thams cad du slob ma la grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed pa 'di ni rdo rje 'chang gis bkag ste/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur ba la slob ma grangs nges med par gsung zhing slob ma grangs nges med pa'i spyod rgyud kyi lhag ma/ dmigs bsal ma mdzad pa'i rgyud sde gzhan gsum gyi dbang gi slob ma la ni grangs nges yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dmigs bsal ma mdzad pa'i zhes pa sgo rum gser sogs las gsungs/ gzhung phal cher las/ dmigs bsal mdzad pa yi/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ spyod rgyud kyi slob ma la grangs nges med pa'i dmigs bsal mdzad pa yi lhag ma rgyud sde gzhan gsum gyi slob ma la ni grangs nges yod ces pa'o/ /rgyud sde gzhan gsum gyi dbang gi slob ma la grangs nges yod pa 'di ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas slob ma gcig gam gsum/ /lnga 'am yang na bdun dag gam/ /nyi shu rtsa ni lnga yi bar/ /zung du ma gyur yongs su gzung / /de las lhag pa'i slob ma ni/ /yongs su gzung bar mi shis so/ 'bru tha'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di ni rgyud sde gzhan gsum po kun la shes byed du 'jug pa yin no/ /spyod rgyud kyi dbang gi slob ma la grangs nges med par gsungs te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gcig gnyis bzhi las lhag kyang rung / /spyad mi dgos pas gzung bar bya/ /zhes dang / des byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir sems can tshad med pa yongs su gzung bar bya'o/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ de bas lhag pa'i/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu ste/ rgyud sde gzhan gsum po'i dbang gi slob ma nub gcig la nyer lnga las lhag pa mi rung ste/ nub gcig la slob ma nyer lnga po de bas grangs lhag pa'i slob ma la dbang gi cho ga phal che ba la dgongs sam/ yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ mtshan mo gcig la tshar bar mi nus la zhag de'i mtshan mor cho ga ma tshar na cho ga nyams par 'gyur bar gsungs pas so/ /de yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ yi dam gyi lha yang nyi ma nub pa ste mtshan mo'i dus na nges par slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlab kyis 'du la/ sang nyi ma shar bar ma gyur bar lha mchod nas gshegs su gsol bar shis zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'di ni bya ba'i/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu ste/ dbang gi slob ma nyi shu rtsa lngar grangs nges par gsungs pa'i gsang ba spyi rgyud 'di ni chos can/ khyod spyod rgyud sogs rgyud sde gzhan gyi cho ga la sbyar bar bya ba ma yin te/ khyod bya ba'i rgyud yin pas so/ /snyam na khyab pa med de/ spyi rgyud kyi lung 'di bya rgyud las gzhan pa'i rgyud rnams kun la'ang shes byed du 'jug par gsang ba spyi rgyud nyid las 'di skad du gsungs pa'i phyir te/ rgyud sde gang du dbang dang rab tu gnas la sogs pa'i las ni yod par gyur ba la dbang la sogs pa'i las rnams kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga rnam pa gsal po med pa der ni gsang ba spyi yi rgyud dag las gsungs pa'i cho ga slob dpon mkhas pas brten zhes de skad du gsungs pa'i cho ga 'di ni/ dbang bskur sogs gsung la/ slob ma'i grangs nges sogs gsal por ma gsung pa'i rgyud rnams kun la shes byed du 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor ma dag pa'i dbang bskur smin byed min pa dgag pa ni/ deng sang / zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gnyis te/ deng sang rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs mi byed cing /

rang bzo'i phag mo'i dbang bskur sogs byed pa kha cig kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud sde las gsungs pa yi dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mi byed par ma gsungs pa'i g.yung drung ris kyi dkyil 'khor dang nas 'dra dang padma 'dab brgyad la sogs pa bris nas dbang bskur byed pa thos/ de ni mi 'thad de/ g.yung drung ris sogs kyis dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra dag tu slob ma la dbang bskur yang sngags kyi sdom pa thob par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ dkyil 'khor de dag du dbang bskur yang sdom pa mi thob pa 'di yi rgyu mtshan yod pa bshad kyis nyon ces nyan par gdam nas/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyi'i rten 'brel snod kyi 'jig rten la yul sum cu so gnyis gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi dur khrod brgyad yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nang gi rten 'brel lus la spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa sum cu so gnyis dang / sna bug gnyis gcig tu bgrangs ba'i bu ga brgyad dang / gzhan yang gsang ba'i rten 'brel phyi nang gi gnas de dag la dbang byed pa byang chub kyi sems dang rlung gi rten 'brel dang / mdor na phyi lus la 'dom gang gru bzhi yod pa dang / nang sems la byang phyogs so bdun yod pa'i rten 'brel gyi stobs kyis phyi nang gzhan gsum dang dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs 'byung ba yin gyi g.yung drung ris la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di la phyi nang gi rten 'brel de lta bu bsgrig mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /shes bya chos can/ ma dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sangs rgyas rnams kyis bkag pa yin te/ ma dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas phyi nang gi rten 'brel bsgrig mi nus pa dang / dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas rten 'brel zab mo bsgrig par nus pa des na ste de'i phyir ro/

/bzhi pa cho ga ma dag pa'i dbang bskur smin byed yin pa dgag pa la gsum ste/ ma dag pa'i dbang bskur byung tshul brjod/ de yi byin rlabs bgegs kyi yin par bstan/ cho ga dag pa'i byin rlabs rnam dag tu bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang bskur byed pa/ zhes sogs rkang pa bdun te/ deng sang dbang bskur byed pa phal cher yang slob ma brgya stong la sogs pa grangs med pa dus gcig la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dbang gi cho ga rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud sde las gsungs pa bzhin mi shes par skabs ma 'brel ba dang / lung dang rigs pa bla ma'i gsung dang 'gal zhing nyams pa yi dbang gi cho ga'i gzugs brnyan byed pa la dbang bskur yin zhes blun po rnams smra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de yi lus ngag zhes sogs rkang pa drug ste/ cho ga ma dag pa'i dbang gi byin rlabs bgegs kyis bslad pa yin te/ ma dag pa'i dbang bskur byed pa'i dus su/ slob ma de yi lus ngag yid gsum gyi rnam pa gdon gyis bsgyur nas 'phar g.yo sogs byung ba la dbang gi byin rlabs yin par 'khrul pa mang yang dpal ldan dam pa dang po ste dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ cho ga nyams pa'i byin rlabs kun/ /bgegs kyi yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i don ni/ sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga nyams pa'i sgo gsum gyi byin rlabs kun phyag dar khrod kyi sha za la sogs pa'i bgegs kyi bar chad yin par rgyal bas gsungs zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni cho ga dag par/ zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis te/ dbang gi cho ga dag par gyur pa las byung ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi rnam pa 'gyur ba sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs yin par gsung ste/ rgyud las/ dbang dang rjes gnang thob nas ni/ /ma bsnyen par yang de la ni/ /lha ni 'go zhing de la gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa smin byed kyi dbang mi dgos par bstan pa la bzhi ste/

dbang bskur med par zab lam sgom pa dgag dbang bskur med par dbang rab smin pa dgag sems bskyed tsam gyis gsang sngags bsgom pa dgag zhar la smin byed nor pa gzhan yang dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang bskur med kyang / zhes sogs rkang pa bco lnga ste/ kha cig smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba med kyang gsang sngags kyi lam zab mo bsgom na 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'grub bo snyam na de ni mi 'thad de/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur med par gsang sngags kyi lam zab mo bsgom pa na gang zag de ngan 'gror skye ba'i rgyu ru gsungs pa'i phyir/ gang las na/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba dang thob pa med na ni cho ga'i dngos grub thob pa med de/ dper na bye ma rtsir yang mar 'byung ba med pa bzhin du skyes bu gang zhig rgyud lung zab mo'i nga rgyal gyis dbang bskur med par 'chad pa dang / nyan par byed pa'i slob dpon slob ma gnyis ka shi ma thag dngos grub cung zad thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ rgyu mtshan de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa la ni dbang nod pa zhu/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rgyud sde gzhan dam pa dang po las kyang / dbang bskur med par sngags 'chad dang / /zab mo'i de nyid bsgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba med/ /ces dang / rdo rje phreng ba las/ dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad pa/ /sgrub pos sngags kyi don shes kyang / /shi nas ngu 'bod chen por ltung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ don bsdu ba sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas/ smin byed kyi dbang zhu ba la 'bad par bya ste/ smin byed kyi dbang rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba yin pa de ltar du rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kha cig gang zag zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/

phyag rgya ba kha cig gang zag dbang po rab smin par byed pa phag mo'i byin rlabs yin pas dbang bskur mi dgos la/ gang zag 'bring dang tha ma dag la ni/ phag mo'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dgos zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zag rab 'bring / zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gcig ste/ phag mo'i byin rlabs gang zag dbang po rab smin par byed pa min te/ gang zag rab 'bring gsum ka la phag mo'i byin rlabs smin byed du rgyud sde kun las gsung pa med pa'i phyir/ de nyid bsdus pa las gsung pa min nam zhe na/ 'phags pa rnams kyi gang zag dbang po rab rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti dang / zla ba bzang po sogs sprul pa yi ni dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur bar mdzad ces de nyid 'dus pa sogs las gsung pa ni/ sngon gyi cho ga 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi spyod yul yin gyi deng sang gang zag dbang po rab 'bring kun/ rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan gyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur bya bar mngon brjod bla ma sogs las gsung mod kyi/ rdul tshon las gzhan sprul pa yi ni dkyil 'khor du so so skye bo smin par byed pa rgyud sde las bkag go /gzhung kha cig tu gzhan gyi zhes pa'ang snang ngo // ༈ //gzhung 'di la dri ba/ shāka rdul tshon min par smin byed kyi/ /dbang bskur deng sang mi rung na/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i ras bris kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur nas/ /phag mo'i byin rlabs mdzad 'di ci/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ 'di la rgya gar na dus kyi 'khor lo'i rjes su 'brang nas nā ro pas dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel par/ dbang bdun po 'di dag ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor spangs nas gzhan ras bris la sogs pas dbang bskur bar bya ba min te/ zhes rdul tshon kho na dgos par bshad pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi thog mar rgyud smin pa la dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan dgos pas rdul tshon kho na dgos par bzhed pa ni srol chen po gcig tu snang /

yang a bhi dha na las/ dkyil 'khor drug gsung pa'i nang nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang nas/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje dang / rdo rje dril bu pas/ smin byed la ras bris rung bar gsung shing / de bzhin du/ grub chen klu'i byang chub kyis/ slob ma'i don kun bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /'khor lo rnam brgyad bri bar bya/ /zhes dkyil 'khor brgyad gsung pa'i nang du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gsung pa dang / slob dpon dgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ras bris la brten pa mdzad pa rnams ni/ srol chen po gcig tu snang ngo / /de la bstan bcos 'dir lam gyi rim pa thams cad birwapa'i dgongs pa gzhir bzhag nas rdul tshon dgos par gsungs la/ bde mchog gi skabs su rje sa chen gyis/ nag po dkyil chog ras bris la brten pa mdzad pa lta bu/ ras bris kyang bzhed pas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas phag mo'i byin rlabs mdzad pa yang dgongs pa de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /'di yang dogs dpyod dgos pa'i dri bar snang ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /kha cig bdag gi ston pa la/ rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du zhes sogs gsungs pa tsam la brten nas/ smin byed dbang gi dkyil 'khor yin na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor kho na dang / yang las dang po pa smin byed kyi dkyil 'khor yin na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin pas khyab par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ spyir smin byed dbang gi dkyil 'khor la/ rdul tshon dang / ras bris dang / lus dkyil dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bzhi gsung pa dang / khyad par ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed rung ba ni/ slob dpon rtse mos dbang chu chen mor/ ras bris la brten pa'i lugs 'di ni/ bde mchog gi a bhi dha na la brten nas/

rdo rje dril bu pa dang / dga' rab rdo rje la sogs pas gsungs la/ rgya gar na yang cho ga phal cher 'di la byed cing / bla ma gong ma rnams kyang skabs su phyag len 'di la mdzad pas/ lugs 'di ha cang mi legs pa yang min no/ /zhes dang / rje btsun grags pas/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis la/ ras bris la brten pa bcu gnyis gsung pas so/ /gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ bi rū pa'i man ngag gi lugs la/ las dang smin byed kyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon kho na la bzhed ces pa'o// ༈ //yang dri ba/ smin byed min pa'i dbang bskur las/ /sdom gsum thob pa yod dam med/ /med na de las gang zhig thob/ /yod na de yang smin byed du/ /thal bar 'gyur ba ma yin nam/ /des na smin byed min pa yi/ /dbang bskur bzhed dam mi bzhed dris/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ thog mar sems bskyed blang nas ni/ /de rjes sems bskyed cho ga las/ /sdom pa thob pa yod dam med/ /med na de las gang zhig thob/ /yod na de yang dang po yi/ /sems bskyed cho gar 'gyur min nam/ /zhes khyod nyid la phar 'dri ste/ de lan gang smras pa de nyid 'di'i lan gyi ched du btang bar bya'o/ /des tshigs rkang phyi ma gnyis kyis lan kyang 'grub mod/ rje btsun gyi dbang gi rab dbye bcu gnyis gsung pa rtogs na 'di 'dra'i dri ba gang na srid/ de la yid mi ches na yang rgyu dus dang / lam dus kyi dbang gi khyad par tsam zhig shes na yang / smin byed min pa'i dbang bskur bzhed mi bzhed dri ba'i don med do/ /zhes lan mdzad do/ /don hril dril na/ bi rū pa'i bzhed pa ltar na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed thob nas de rjes ras bris sogs su'ang dbang len du rung ba dang / sngar rgyud smin pa zhig gis phyis dbang gang blang kyang / smin byed du mi 'gyur zhing sngags sdom gsar thob kyang med de/ sngar rgyu dus su thob pa'i sdom pa de nyid gong 'phel du byed pa'i thabs tsam yin pa'i phyir/

'on kyang cho ga de dang de'i ngos skal gyis sdom pa gsar thob re bzhed dgos pa 'dra'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ la la sems bskyed/ ces sogs rkang pa gsum ste/ gsang 'dus stod lugs pa dbang bka' med pa la la na re/ dbang ma thob kyang / 'jug pa sems bskyed tsam byas pa la gsang sngags zab mo bsgom pa dang ston du rung bar 'dod ces zer/ 'di ni gsang sngags kyi 'khrul bya ba yin lo/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bya rgyud la rnam par phye ste lan btab pa/ lhag ma gsum la gos gcig tu lan btab pa/ sgrub byed kyi sgo nas 'jug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di yang phye ste/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu bdun te/ dbang bskur med par sems bskyed tsam byas pa la gsang sngags bsgom du 'dod zer ba 'di yang rgyud don so sor phye ste bshad kyis nyon ces gdam nas/ ji ltar yin snyam na 'di ltar yin te/ spyir bya ba'i rgyud la sgo drug tu gsung pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs la nor bu'i rigs/ lnga tsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs dang gsum/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs la padma'i/ rdo rje'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnam pa gsum yod pa'i nang nas padma'i rigs thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa dang / bcu gcig zhal/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gdugs dkar sogs 'ga' zhig la dbang bskur dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed ma thob kyang sgo gsum bsnyung bar gnas pa la sogs pa byed nus na/ gang zag kun gyis bsgrub tu rung bar gsungs te/ don zhags kyi cho ga zhib mo las/ sems can thams cad la nus sam mi nus dris te sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes dang / dud 'gro'i rnal lam du yang sgrogs shig ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang bya rgyud rdo rje'i rigs dam tshig gsum bkod pa dang / la sogs pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa rnams las/ 'jug pa sems bskyed thob nas dbang bskur ma thob kyang ni zhi drag la sogs pa'i phrin las 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i phyir/

cho ga shes na bsgrub chog par gnang ste/ ji skad du/ gang zhig byung chub sems brtan zhing / /blo gros chags pa med pa dang / /thams cad dag kyang mi byed pa/ /des 'di nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs legs par grub pa dang / dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud yan chad du rgyud rang rang gi dbang bskur ma thob na 'jug pa sems bskyed thob kyang gsang sngags spyod pa bkag go /de yang legs par grub pa'i rgyud las/ dbang bskur ma byas pa dag la/ /cho ga shes pas sngags mi sbyin/ /rgyud shes mkhas pas gsang sngags dang / /phyag rgya cho ga zhib mo dang / /rgyud dang dkyil 'khor bshad pa dag /dkyil 'khor ma zhugs la ma sbyin/ /zhes dang / sogs pa dpung bzang las/ gang dag rigs dang dbang bskur cho ga med/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / /gang dag byang chub sems ni ma bskyed pa/ /nga yis gsang sngags bzlas na phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes rgyas par gsungs pa la ltos te gsal ba'i phyir ro// ༈ //don yod zhags sogs 'ga' zhig las/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig la dri ba/ shāka dbang bskur sems bskyed ma thob kyang / /don zhags la sogs bsgrub rung na/ /do skor ba yi dris lan las/ /rnam rgyal don zhags la sogs pa/ /sems bskyed thob nas sbyong dgos par/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa gang du rtsal/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ dbang bskur sems bskyed ma thob kyang don zhags la sogs bsgrub tu rung bar gsung pa ni/ las sgrib 'dag pa'i ched du snyung gnas kyi cho ga la dgongs la/ 'jug pa sems bskyed thob nas sbyong dgos par gsung pa ni/ bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi sgom tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa la dgongs te/ sbyong ba'i don yang dbang bskur dang rjes gnang yang thob pa la dgongs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lhag ma rgyud sde/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ bya rgyud kyi lhag ma spyod pa dang /

rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde gsum po la rang gi dbang bskur thob pa ma gtogs pa 'jug pa sems bskyed pa tsam la brten pa yi yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa gsung pa med do/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang bskur nang gi zhes sogs rkang pa drug ste/ legs par grub pa yan chad du/ dbang bskur med na 'jug pa sems bskyed byas na yang gsang sngags zab mo bsgom pa dang ston pa la ltung ba yod par rgyal bas gsungs te/ dbang bskur ba nang gi rten 'brel bsgrig pa yin la/ 'jug pa sems bskyed pa tsam la ni nang gi rten 'brel bsgrig pa med pa des na ste de'i phyir/ de ltar rgyal bas gsungs te/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du ma smra zhig smras na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na rgyud sde bzhi po so so'i rnam dbye ma 'dres par shes dgos so/ /zhes pa don bsdu ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gtor ma'i dbang bskur/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ dbang bskur med par 'jug pa sems bskyed tsam byas pa yi legs grub yan chad kyi gsang sngags bsgom pa bkag pa'i zhar la smin byed gtor dbang la sogs pa bkag pa yin te/ gtor ma'i dbang bskur zhes bya ba dang / der ma zad ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba dang / ā li kā li'i dbang bskur la sogs pa yang slob ma smin par byed pa'i dbang gi cho ga ru rgyud sde rnal ma kun las gsung pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur gtan nas med dam zhe na/ ma yin te/ 'di'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ni/ cho ga med par dmigs pa gtad pa tsam la dgongs pa yin gyi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas/ slob ma la smin byed kyi dbang bskur byed pa bkag pa ma yin no/ /'di la ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa ma thob pa dang / thob pa'i bye brag gis slob dpon rang gis ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor blta nus kyang /

slob ma la ston mi nus pa dang / rang gi blta nus shing gzhan la ston nus pa yod pa ni/ slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes 'brog mi lo tsā ba la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa dbang bskur dgos kyang 'khrul par spyod pa dgag pa la lnga ste/ dbang bskur ba'i dus la 'khrul pa dgag pa/ slob ma'i rgyud la 'khrul pa dgag pa/ bskur byed kyi dkyil 'khor la 'khrul pa dgag pa/ rgyud sde'i khyad par la 'khrul pa dgag pa/ chos sgo'i ming la 'khrul pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'ga' zhig gsang sngags zhes sogs rkang pa bcu ste/ gsang 'dus stod lugs pa 'ga' dang / rnam dbye chung ba'i sngags par khas 'che ba 'ga' zhig na re/ gsang sngags da lta dbang ma thob par spyod cing dbang bskur ba ni phyis nas ste yo byad 'dzoms pa'i dus su zhu zhes khas len pa ni/ dbang ston mar byed pa yin zhes zer/ de ni mi 'thad de/ gsang sngags dbang ma thob par da lta spyod cing dbang bskur phyis nas khas len par byed pa 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnam dag ma yin te/ smin byed kyi dbang ma thob pa la gsang sngags kyi chos bshad na/ yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba bsgrogs pa bdun pa yin/ /zhes slob dpon rtsa ba'i ltung ba can du 'gyur zhing / slob ma'ang phyis dbang len pa'i sngon du nyams pa ste ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ slob mas dbang ma blang bar gsang sngags zab mo spyad pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / de nyid bsdus pa las/ de ni 'di ltar/ dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i sems can de dag gi phyag rgya bcing par byas nas de'i tshe de dag de ltar 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas de dag the tshom du gyur te gnod pa ma spang par myur ba nyid du dus byas nas dmyal ba chen po mnar med pa/ zhes bya bar ltung bar gyur to/ /khyod nyid kyang ngan song du ltung bar 'gyur ro/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar nyams par gyur pa rdo rje theg pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi snod min zhes ni rgyal bas gsungs te/ dus 'khor las/ dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang / /sngags kyi de nyid bsgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba min/ /zhes dang / rdo rje phreng ba las/ dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /slob dpon slob ma mtshungs par ni/ /shin tu ngu 'bod chen por ltung / /zhes dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /ces sogs dang / 'phags pa lha'i bzhi brgya pa las kyang / nyams par gyur pa dam chos kyi/ /snod ni cis kyang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na dam pa'i chos kyis 'bras bu ci zhig bsgrub par byed legs par soms la sangs rgyas sgrub par byed na chos nas 'byung ba bzhin gyis shig go /gnyis pa ni/ la la sems nyid/ ces sogs rkang pa bcu dgu ste/ spyod yul ba la la na re/ sems stong pa nyid du ma rtogs na dbang bskur thob kyang 'tshang rgya ba la mi phan zer/ gal te sems stong pa nyid du rtogs par gyur na/ dbang bskur bya yang mi dgos lo/ lo grag zer gsum ni ma rang pa'i tshig go /shes bya chos can/ 'o na sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid du ma rtogs na so thar sogs kyi sdom pa bsrungs kyang 'tshang rgya ba la ci zhig phan te mi phan la/ gal te sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid rtogs par gyur na sdom pa bsrung yang ci zhag dgos te mi dgos par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gzhan yang / rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs kyang sems stong pa nyid rtogs na bya mi dgos pa dang / gal te sems stong pa nyid du ma rtogs na phag mo'i byin rlabs byas kyang 'tshang rgya ba la ci zhig phan te mi phan par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ thal ba gnyis ka la 'dod na/ sdom pa bsrung mi dgos par thal ba dang /

phag mo'i byin rlabs kyang byed mi dgos par thal lo/ /de bzhin du theg pa chen por sems bskyed pa dang / bla ma la gus pa dang / chos 'chad nyan la sogs pa cho ga'i rnam gzhag kun la dam bca' rtags su bkod pa'i rigs pa'i tshul 'di mtshungs so/ /rgyu mtshan des na rab byung gi sdom pa mkhan slob las len pa dang / rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs chos sgo ba las len pa dang / theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed lan pa'i cho ga 'bad nas byed dgos zer bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i dbang bskur mi dgos zhes smra ba 'di ni gsang sngags zab mo spong ba'i bdud kyi gsang tshig yin pas spang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kha cig cho ga zhes sogs rkang pa gsum ste/ phyag rgya ba kha cig cho ga'i rnam gzhag med bzhin du bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor la dbang bzhi rdzogs par len par 'dod de/ lus btsun mo lta bur sku la 'khril/ /snying la phrad de dpral bar btugs/ /dus der dbang rdzogs sems la bskur/ /chos rdzogs don gyi ngo bo mthong / /zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ cho ga med pa la gnod byed bstan/ cho ga yod pa'i sgrub byed brjod/ bden gnyis kyi sgo nas cho ga thams cad mtshungs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'o na dge tshul/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ shes bya chos can/ 'o na dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa la sogs pa yang cho ga med par bla ma'i lus las cis mi len te len rigs par thal/ cho ga med par dbang bzhi rdzogs pa bla ma'i lus las len pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gzhan yang / sems bskyed len pa'i cho ga ci zhig dgos te mi dgos par thal/ sems bskyed kyang ni cho ga med par bla ma yi sku nyid las ni thob pa'i phyir/ rtags dam bca' la khas/ gzhan yang / rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs kyang chos can/ khyod chos sgo ba las blang ci dgos te mi dgos par thal/

khyod bla ma'i sku nyid las thob pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum khas blang / de bzhin du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdo rgyud las gsung pa yi sdom gsum gyi cho ga zab mo thams cad spong rigs par thal/ sdom pa gsum gyi cho ga thams cad kyang bla ma'i sku nyid las blang pas chog pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gal te cho ga zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ shes bya chos can/ rigs 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa yang dbang bskur gyi cho ga med na thob par mi nus te/ gal te so thar gyi cho ga nyams par gyur na/ so thar gyi sdom pa dang sems bskyed kyi cho ga nyams par gyur na'ang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa 'chags par mi 'gyur zhing rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i cho ga nyams par gyur na phag mo'i byin rlabs 'jug par mi 'gyur pa'i phyir na'o/ /rgyu mtshan des na so thar dang sems bskyed la sogs pa'i cho ga gzhan dag la 'bad pa chen po byed bzhin du dbang bskur gyi cho ga bya mi dgos zhes 'dor bar byed pa ni/ thabs la bslu ba'i bdud yod ces mdo rgyan las gsung pa 'dir yang dran par bya'o/ /'di dag kyang cho ga med par smin byed kyi dbang bla ma'i lus dkyil las len pa bkag pa yin gyi spyir bla ma'i lus dkyil las dbang len pa bkag pa ni ma yin te/ lam dus kyi dbang dang dril bu lus dkyil sogs du ma yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ de phyir dam pa'i/ zhes sogs rkang pa nyer gsum ste/ sngags sdom 'bog pa'i dbang gi cho ga 'dor ba mi rigs te/ dper na phag mo'i cho ga med na de'i byin rlabs mi 'jug pas phag mo'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga yod pa bzhin du/ dbang gi cho ga med na sngags sdom ma thob pa de'i phyir/ 'o na cho ga de dag kun rdzob dang don dam gang du yod ce na/ don dam par sdom pa de la 'bogs byed kyi cho ga gang yang med cing / 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid kyang yod pa min na/

sdom pa sogs 'bog pa'i cho ga gzhan yod pa min pa lta smos ci dgos te dam pa'i don du ste yang dag par na 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams thams cad yod med sogs spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu yi chos kyi dbye ba thams cad kun rdzob tu yod pa yin pas so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang / byang chub sems bskyed dang / dbang bskur la sogs pa'i cho ga dang / ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i dmigs pa ji snyed pa dang / phyi nang gi rten 'brel zab mo thams cad dang / rgyu sa dang lam gyi dbye ba dang / 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa yang kun rdzob tu yod pa yin gyi don dam du yod pa ma yin te/ lang gshegs las/ kun rdzob tu ni thams cad yod/ /dam pa'i don du yod ma yin/ /des na dngos po gcig nyid la/ /yod dang med du ji ltar 'gal/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /chos thams cad kun rdzob tu yod pa dang / don dam du yod pa min pa de 'dra'i dbye ba legs par shes nas ni/ kun rdzob tu cho ga byed na phag mo'i byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur gyi cho ga thams cad kyi cho ga don dam du byed pa min na cho ga de thams cad dor bar byos te/ cho ga thams cad kun rdzob tu yod mtshungs dang / don dam du med mtshungs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos nas ma bshad pa'i phag mo'i byin rlabs smin byed kyi cho ga yin pa la la dgos zer bzhin du/ chos nas gsung pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la sogs pa la la bya mi dgos zhes smra ba spyod ldan mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dkrugs pa yin pa dang / bdud kyi byin rlabs zhes bya ba yang 'di 'dra'i rigs can yin par gsungs te/ mdo bsdud pa las/ chos btang nas ni chos min bya ba gcod gyur ba/ /lam bor lam gol 'gro ba 'di ni bdud kyi las/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ phyogs snga ma brjod pa dang /

de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kha cig bya ba'i/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ sngon gyi don zhags dang / phyag rgya ba kha cig bya ba'i rgyud dang sogs pa spyod rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud la'ang smin byed dbang bzhi'i cho ga byed pa dang / thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa la sogs la'ang grol byed rim gnyis bsgom par byed pa thos so/ /mkhas pa gzhon nu seng ges 'di paṇḍi ta a bha ya ka ra'i 'dod pa la sbyor ba ni/ 'di bod kyi 'dod pa 'gog pa'i skabs yin zhing bya rgyud la dbang bzhi sbyar ba/ paṇḍi ta de'i dgongs pa min pas mi 'thad snyam du sems so/ /zhes kun mkhyen gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di yang sangs rgyas/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu bdun te/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la smin byed dbang bzhi dang / grol byed rim pa gnyis 'dod pa 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa min pa de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin te/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud gsum ka la rgyud sde rang ngos nas smin byed dbang bzhi dang ni grol byed rim gnyis med de/ gal te yod na rgyud gsum po de dag kyang chos can/ khyod rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud nyid du 'gyur bar thal/ khyod rgyud sde rang ngos nas smin byed dbang bzhi dang grol byed rim gnyis yod pa'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ smin byed kyi dus su dbang bzhi dang ni grol byed kyi dus su rim pa gnyis yod pa ni/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi khyad chos yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi phrin yig las/ bcom ldan khyod kyi gsang sngags lam/ /rim pa gnyis su bsdus te gsung / /zhes sogs la 'khrul nas rgyud sde 'og ma la rim gnyis yod par bsam ste/ dbang bzhi med pas de la ltos pa'i rim gnyis med pa yin gyi/ spyir rim gnyis yod do zhes 'dod pa yang mi 'thad par gsungs so/ /des na mtshan nyid theg par grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam dbye mi phyed cing gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang dang lam gyi rim pa mi shes pas rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis sbyar ba'i rnam gzhag legs legs 'dra na yang lham bzo ba'i dpe zhwa mo la bkab pa dang 'dra ba yin pas mi 'thad do/

/rgyu mtshan des na rgyud sde bzhi po yi dbang dang / lam gyi dbye ba la mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba rnam pa bzhi yod de/ dbang gi bab mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pa ni ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ chu'i dbang bskur dbu rgyan dang / /bya ba'i rgyud las rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming / /spyod pa'i rgyud las rab tu gsal/ /phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang / /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar phye/ /de ni drug gi bye brag dbang / /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma yi ni mtshan/ /gsang ba yi ni dbang rgyal bshad/ /shes rab ye shes bla na med/ /bzhi pa de ltar de bzhin no/ /zhes gsung pa ltar yin la/ lam gyi dbye ba mi 'dra ba bzhi ni/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la mtshan bcas mtshan med gnyis gnyis las/ nang sel gyi mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba dang / rnal 'byor chen po la rim gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams su yod do/ /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi la dbang dang lam mi 'dra ba bzhi bzhi yod pa las rgyud sde rang rang nas dbang gi cho ga dang grol byed kyi lam gsung pa bzhin bsgrub par byas na rgyud sde de dang de nas gsung pa'i dngos grub 'byung bas lugs ma 'dres pa la mkhas par bya'o// ༈ //bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum ka /zhes sogs la dri ba/ shā rgyud sde 'og ma gsum po la/ /dbang bzhi rim gnyis mi rung na/ /rgyud sde gong ma'i rgyas bkab nas/ /rung bar 'chad pa 'di ci zhig /ces pa'i lan ni/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi cho ga rang rkang la dbang bzhi rim gnyis med kyang / rgyud sde 'og ma'i lha la rgyud sde gong ma'i cho gas rgyas bkab pa'i tshe/ rung ba de nyid min pas khyed rang gis rgyu mtshan bkod bzhin du gzhan la rgyu mtshan dri ba 'di rgol phyir rgol gnyis ka la don med do/ /spyir 'di 'dra'i rigs can kun la rgyud sde de'i lha dang rgyud sde'i de'i rgyud ma nor ba gal che/

zhes gsungs/ yang dri ba/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad dgos shing / /smin grol rim gnyis la bzhed na/ /rgyud sde 'og ma'i rang rkang las/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub pa ji ltar bya/ /de la'ang smin grol mi bzhed dam/ /zhes pa'i lan ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i sngags sdom gyi skabs 'dir rdo rje theg pa zhes spyir btang ba phal cher skabs thob kyi bla med la 'jug pas/ de'i smin grol gnyis dbang bzhi dang rim pa gnyis la bzhed pa yin gyi/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum rang rang gi smin grol yod kyang / dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis yod mi dgos so/ /rgyud sde 'og ma'i rang rkang las sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i tshul ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang 'dra bar sa bcu pa'i bar bsgrub nus pa yin gyi/ bla med la ma zhugs par sbas pa'i sa gsum bgrod mi nus pas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa bsgrub pa la dgongs nas/ bla med kyi smin grol kho na dgos par gsung pa ste/ 'di dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /sa bcu gcig pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'bras bur bzhag pa ni/ sa bcu pa man chad rang lam gyis bgrod nus shing / de yang lam du 'dod la/ rang lugs kyi 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag gcig kyang dgos pas/ de'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ bla med la ma zhugs par lam rang nyid kyis thob par mi nus pa'i gnad kyang yod mod kyi da dung gzhan gyis rtogs par dka'o/ /zhes lan mdzad do/ /'di ni lam 'bras glegs bam lam 'byung ldog gi skabs su/ sa bcu pa man chad pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyis bgrod/ de nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam du zhugs te/ sbas pa'i sa gnyis dang mthar phyin gyi sa phyed bgrod nas sa bcu gsum pa thob ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no/ /de la kho na re/ sa bcu gcig pa chos can/ khyod sngags lam la ma ltos par/ phar phyin rang lam gyis bgrod nus par thal/

khyod phar phyin pa rang lugs kyi mthar thug gi sa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ phar phyin theg pa bas sa bcu gcig pa sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / rdo rje theg pa bas sa bcu gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dod pa'i phyir te/ mdo sngags gnyis sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid la mthun/ mtshan gzhi la mi mthun pa'i rnam gzhag 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ thal 'gyur snga ma la ma khyab pa 'dra'o/ /lnga pa la gsum ste/ mos pa chos sgo yin pa dgag dbang las gsang sngags logs na yod pa dgag dbang bas gsang sngags logs na med pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dang po la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ la la dbang bskur/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ phyag rgya ba la la/ gal te smin byed kyi dbang bskur ma byas kyang gsang sngags kyi chos la mos pa thob na gsang sngags kyi lam bsgom du rung ste/ gsang sngags la mos pa thob pa de nyid gsang sngags zab mo'i chos kyi sgo yin pas so/ /zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'o na sdom pa/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu bzhi ste/ 'o na shes bya chos can/ sdom pa ma thob kyang sdom pa len pa la mos pa thob na sdom pa bsrung bas chog gam ci ste chog par thal/ rab byung gi sdom pa ma thob kyang rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa la mos pa thob pa nyid sdom pa len pa'i sgo yin pas so/ /rtags dam bca' la khas/ gzhan yang / theg chen sems bskyed ma thob kyang / sems bskyed la mos pa tsam thob na/ sems bskyed gsar du blang yang ci zhig dgos te mi dgos par thal/ sems bskyed kyi sdom pa ma thob kyang / sems bskyed pa la mos pa thob pa nyid byang chub spyod pa ste/ sems bskyed pa'i sgo yin pas so/ /rtags khyab khas/ de bzhin du/ 'jig rten pa ltar na/ lo thog la mos pa tsam thob na so nam la yang 'bad pa bya ci dgos te mi dgos par thal/ so nam ma byas kyang lo thog la mos pa thob pa nyid bza' rgyu bza' ba'i sgo yin pas so/

/sngar bzhin khas/ des na dbang ma thob kyang gsang sngags la mos pa thob na/ gsang sngags bsgom du rung zer ba 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi chos lugs log pa kun gong du brjod pa de 'dra'i mgo mtshungs kyi rigs pa rnams kyis sun dbyung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ des na chos sgo/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu bzhi ste/ des na chos sgo zhes bya ba rgyud sde'i tha snyad la med kyang gsar du bod kyi phyag rgya ba 'ga' zhig gis/ smin byed kyi dbang bzhi mi shes par phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam shes pa'i gang zag gcig la chos sgo ba zhes bya bar btags pa 'di yi ming gi 'khrul gzhi byas nas dbang bskur ba gsang sngags pa'i chos kyi sgo tsam yin gyi/ 'tshang rgya ba yi chos dbang las gzhan pa zhig bsgom rgyu logs na yod do zhes ma sbyang pa'i blun po rnams kyis mun bsgom byas so/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ shes bya chos can/ 'o na dge slong gi sdom pa yang gang zag dge slong du byed pa'i sgo tsam yin gyi/ dge slong gi sdom pa'i ngo bo zhig dge slong gi sdom pa las gzhan nas rtsal du yod dam ci ste yod par thal/ khyod kyi dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du 'bras kyi so nam byed pa yang 'bras kyi ston thog 'byung ba'i sgo tsam yin gyi 'bras kyi kha zas 'byung ba'i thabs gzhan zhig so nam las logs na rtsal du yod dam ci ste yod par thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ rim bzhin khas blangs so/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ des na snying gtam/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ 'tshang rgya ba'i chos dbang las gzhan med pa des na snying gtam 'di ltar yin pa yid la zungs shig de ci zhe na/ dbang bskur ba gsang sngags kyi chos kyi sgo tsam min par 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel zab mo bsgrig pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ gsang sngags pa dbang bskur ba rten 'brel lam du byed pa yin pas so/

/dper na ston thog 'byung ba'i thabs so nam byed pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ phung po khams dang / zhes sogs rkang pa bco lnga ste/ 'o na rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ de'i tshul yod pa yin te/ sbyang gzhi slob ma'i phung po khams dang skye mched kyi zhing sa la rdo rje slob dpon gyis dag bya dag byed ngo sprod pa la mkhas pas gdan sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ rig ma dang lha mo'i gdan/ khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan/ gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sa bon dbang gi cho ga khyad par can gyis btab nas ni/ gang zag dbang po rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par byed pa yi thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan des na gang zag dbang po rab ind+ra bhu ti lta bu dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsung pa yang / dbang bskur gsang sngags kyi lam gyi gtso bo yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis grol ba yin gyi/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam du byas nas gsang sngags logs nas bsgom rgyu yod na dbang bskur kho nas ji ltar grol legs par soms shig 'o na gang zag thams cad dbang kho nas grol lam zhe na min te/ dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i gang zag gzhan 'bring dang tha ma dag la rim gnyis bsgom dgos so/ /ji ltar bsgom na/ sngar smin byed kyi dbang bskur thob pa de bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa la dbang don bsgom pa zhes su btags pa yin te/ bskyed rim bsgom pa ni bum dbang gi dus su lus la sprul sku'i sa bon dang / rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ gsang dbang gi dus su ngag la longs sku dang / shes dbang dus su yid la chos sku dang / dbang bzhi pa'i dus su rlung la ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon btab pa de bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa yin pa des na ste de'i phyir ro/ /des na gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa'i sgor zhugs nas dbang bskur ba bzhi las gzhan pa'i chos med de/

sbyang gzhi lus kyang dbang bzhi'i tshul du gnas/ /de la rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bzhi bskur/ de nyid lam gyi dus su yang dbang bzhi'i tshul du bsgom/ 'bras bu'i dus su yang dbang bzhi'i tshul du sangs rgya ba yin pa'i phyir te/ ji skad du/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas gdab cing / /'bras bu la yang rgyu'i rgyas gdab/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas dbang las gzhan pa'i chos gzhan med pa'i dpe ni theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la theg chen sems bskyed min pa'i chos gzhan med pa bzhin te/ de la yang thog mar sems bskyed blang pa'i tshe sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs khyad par can gyi sa bon sems la btab pa yin zhing / de'i tshe nyes spyod spong ba dang / dge ba chos bsdud dang / sems can don byed kyis bsdus pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brlab po che'i sa bon sems la btab pa de nyid bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa las gzhan pa'i theg pa chen po'i chos cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnad 'di dag ni kho bo 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul yin no/ /zhes kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ des na thub pas/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ thub pas rgyud sde thams cad las dbang ma bskur ba'i nyes dmigs dang / bskur ba'i phan yon dpag tu med pa gsung pa'i sgo nas lam thams cad las dbang bskur ba kho na la bsngags pa mdzad pa dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams ci nas bla ma la dbang bskur zhu ba la gus pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dbang bskur ba gsang sngags kyi lam gyi rtsa ba yin pa gong du bshad pa de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud sde las dbang ma bskur ba'i nyes dmigs dang / bskur ba'i phan yon gsung pa yin te/ de yang dbang ma bskur ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ dam pa dang po las/ dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang / /zhes sogs dang /

rdo rje phreng ba las/ yang dag dbang bskur gyis dben na/ /zhes sogs dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim/ /shi ba tsam gyis stong pa nyid/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /ye shes kun gyis stong pa nyid/ /dper na pi waṃ sbyor tshogs kun/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi nus/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral ba ni/ /sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rmongs pa gang zhig dbang med par/ /dbang ni dbang bskur zhes smra ba/ /bye rnyed sangs rgyas bzhugs kyi bar/ /slob mar bcas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / bde mchog las/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni ma mthong bar/ /rnal 'byor pa ni dngos grub 'dod/ /mkha' la khu tshur gyis rdeg dang / /rmongs pa phub ma brdung dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs shing / /dam tshig rnams ni spangs ba dang / /gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas/ /bsgrub kyang ci yang mi 'grub bo/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / /dbang bskur med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gang gis rab gnas ma mthong zhing / /gang gis sbyin sreg ma byas na/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du yang / /de la dngos grub mchog nyid med/ /ces dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /ces sogs dang / gzhung 'dir yang / dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan pas/ /zhes sogs dang / dge slong sdom pa med pa dang / /zhes sogs du ma gsungs so/ /dbang bskur ba'i phan yon ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'bum pa las/ /skal pa sa yar byas pa yi/ /sngon du yod pa'i sdig pa kun/ /de kun 'dzad par gyur pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong bas so/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mchog tu rab zhugs mthong ba na/ /deng khyod sdig pa thams cad las/ /rnam grol bzang por gyur par gnas/ /zhes dang / he ru ka sngon byung las/

dkyil 'khor rgyal po mthong nas ni/ /cung zad de ni mi 'grub med/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rdo rje phreng ba las/ thog mar slob ma gang gis tshe/ /blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi tshe na snod du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dug ni sngags kyis 'joms pa bzhin/ /sngags kyi dag byed bcud len byed/ /de bzhin slob ma dbang sogs kyis/ /ma dag pa ni dag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / phyag chen theg le las/ dang por re zhig gang tshe slob/ /lan gcig dbang rnams kyis ni bskur/ /de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi/ /nges par snod du 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes dang / yang sdom 'byung las/ dbang bskur 'di dag yang dag ldan/ /de ni dam tshig can zhes bya/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas thod pa las/ phyi nang gsang bar bcas pa yi/ /dbang bskur tsam gyi nam mkha' yi/ /dkyil nas rnga yi sgra grags cing / /me tog tsandan char 'bab 'gyur/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa de rnams/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo la ni thim/ /zhes dang / rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rtsi des ji ltar zangs phug nas/ /slar yang zangs su 'gyur mi srid/ /de bzhin ye shes lus phug nas/ /slar yang 'gro drug ltung mi srid/ /ces dang / dpal mchog dang po stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las/ bum pa'i dbang bskur sa brgyad yin/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur sa dgu yin/ /shes rab ye shes bcu yin te/ /bzhi pa bcu gcig par bshad do/ /zhes dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ rgyal ba'i sras po sa brgyad pa/ de srid theg pa dman pas 'jigs/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /zhugs pas bdag nyid grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dkyil 'khor cho ga ji lta bu/ /cho ga chos dang rnal 'byor te/ /gsang ba thar pa yang dag 'byung / /skye ba 'di nyid kho na la/ /rab dga' bsgrub par byed pa yin/ /zhes dang / nag po pa'i dkyil chog las/

dbang bskur 'di dag thob nas ni/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab tu mchod/ /mtshams med pa dang sdig can yang / /mtshon rtsi mthong bas grol bar 'gyur/ /mngon par zhugs pa tsam gyis ni/ /gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gsang ba'i mdo las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yis skye ba bdun nas ni/ /ma bsgom par yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rje sa skya pas/ bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan rgyud don rig /dam tshig mchog bsrung man ngag du mas brgyan/ /snying rje'i rgyud slan bstan bcos du ma shes/ /de yi zhabs rten gsol ba lan mang gdab/ /de yis gnang nas dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /zhugs la dbang bzhi po rnams rdzogs par blangs/ /byin rlabs phra mo tsam gyis ma yin te/ /sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur yin pas so/ /zhes dang / de dag gi don/ gzhung 'dir yang / dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin/ /zhes sogs dang / bla ma rtsal la dbang bzhi blangs/ /zhes sogs du ma gsung pa des na'o/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ la la dbang bskur/ zhes sogs rkang pa lnga ste/ slob dpon ti pu pa dang / ras chung pa la sogs pa la la dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod/ de yang dbang bskur byas kyang dbang ma thob pa dang / dbang ma byas kyang ni thob pa dang gnyis/ byas nas thob pa dang gsum/ dbang ma byas par ma thob pa zhes bya ba rnam pa bzhir 'dod/ yang mchan rnying pa zhig dang / ṭīkka rnying pa kha cig las/ zhang g.yu brag pa la la dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod de/ g.yu brag pa'i lam mchog mthar thug las/ rim gyis gang zag zur tsam smos/ /gang zag rigs ni brjod mi lang / /theg pa mas 'dzeg dgos pa yod/ /che long bslab pas chog pa yod/ /bslab mi dgos pa dag kyang yod/ /dbang ma bskur bar thob pa yod/

/bskur yang ma thob shin tu mang / /bskur na thob la ma bskur na/ /mi thob pa yi rigs kyang yod/ /ye nas dbang dang ldan pa'ang yod/ /de ltar snod kyi rigs shes nas/ /snod dang 'tsham pa'i lag len bya/ /rim gyis pa'i lam dang gang zag gi rigs bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dbang bskur la mu bzhir 'dod pa/ dbang bskur rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud las gsung / zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ mu bzhi sgrub byed kyi lung med pa/ rigs pas bsgrub na kun la mtshungs pa/ mu bzhi yod kyang shes par mi nus pa/ nus na dbang bskur dgos par grub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di 'dra gang na'ang / zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis te/ shes bya chos can/ dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa 'di 'dra rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa bkrugs pa'i rnyad dkar zad pas mi 'thad de/ rgyud sde rnal ma gang na'ang bshad pa med cing dbang bskur rgyal po'i rgyud ni bod kyi rnying ma kha cig gis byas pa yin gyi/ rgyud sde khung ma min pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'on kyang / zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gcig ste/ lung rnam dag nas bshad pa med pa 'on kyang mu bzhir dbye ba 'di yang rigs pas brtag par byas na mi 'thad de/ shes bya chos can/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa phog kyang ma thob pa dang / ma phog kyang thob pa dang / phog nas thob pa dang / ma phog par ma thob pa zhes bya ba mu bzhi dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed la'ang cho ga byas kyang ma thob pa sogs mu bzhi ci'i phyir mi rtsi ste/ rtsi rigs par thal/ dbang bskur la mu bzhir 'dod pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ rigs pa stobs mtshungs so/ /de bzhin du bsgom la'ang mu bzhi rtsi ba cis mi mtshungs te mtshungs par thal/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom kyang bsgom mi skye ba dang / de ma bsgom kyang skye ba dang / la sogs pa bsgom nas skye ba dang / ma bsgom par mi skye ba'i mu bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ rtsa ba'i dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir ro/

/gzhan yang de 'dra'i mu bzhi cho ga kun la rtsir yod bzhin du so thar dang sems bskyed bsgom pa sogs gzhan la mu bzhi mi rtsi bar dbang bskur nyid la mu bzhi rtsi ba ni gsang sngags spong ba'i bdud kyi gsang tshig yin par dogs te/ dper na sman pa g.yo can gyi rtsa ba'i sman bzang shos bor nas gzhan sman mang po sbyin kyang nad pa mi bsos pa ltar gsang sngags chos kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur bor nas gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag gzhan bsgom kyang 'tshang mi rgya ba yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ gal te mu bzhi/ zhes sogs rkang pa drug ste/ rgya la gal te de 'dra'i dbang bskur mu bzhi yod du chug na yang mu bzhi so so'i mtshan nyid dam bye brag phye nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi rnam 'gyur shes par mi nus la/ ci ste de 'dra shes par nus na ni/ de yi mtshan nyid tha dad pa 'di ltar yod ces smra dgos te smra mi nus so/ /'ol tshod kyis smras kyang rtog pa'i rang bzo min pa/ khung ma'i lung dang mthun pa khyed la smra rgyu med de/ de 'dra'i mu bzhi lung tshad ldan gang las kyang bshad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ gal te mu bzhi/ zhes sogs rkang pa bcu ste/ gal te gang zag gzhan dbang bskur byas kyang mi thob pa dang / ma byas par mi thob pa/ ma byas kyang thob pa gsum la/ dbang bskur mi byed kyang / dbang bskur byas na thob pa'i gang zag la dbang bskur ci'i phyir byed mi dgos te dgos par thal/ dbang bskur mu bzhir dbye ba bden srid pa'i phyir na'o/ /de la kho na re/ gang zag gzhan gsum la dbang bskur byed mi dgos pas/ byas na thob pa'i gang zag la'ang dbang bskur mi dgos so zhe na/ shes bya chos can/ skyes bu nad med pa la sman spong bas nad pa la yang sman spong ngam cis te spong rigs par thal/ gang zag gzhan gsum la dbang bskur byed mi dgos pas byas na thob pa'i de la'ang dbang bskur byed mi dgos pa 'thad pa'i phyir ro/

/de ltar mu bzhis ma byas kyang thob pa de tshe 'dir dbang bskur ma byas kyang skye ba snga mar dbang bskur thob pa lta bu la zer na/ de ni shin tu yod de/ sngags sdom sems kyi rjes 'brang yin pa'i phyir/ dbang bskur gtan nas ma byas kyang dbang bskur thob pa yod pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ dbang bskur thob pa'i don sngags sdom thob pa la 'jog cing / sngags kyi sdom pa'ang dbang bskur ba la rags las pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs 'di gong du drangs pa'i rgyud lung thams cad kyis grub bo/ /des na dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa 'di 'dra ba'i chos log thams cad ni bdud kyi byin rlabs yin par shes par byas nas spong dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi mthun pa'i grub mtha' yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dbang las thob pa'i dam tshig la 'khrul pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kha cig gsang sngags/ zhes sogs rkang pa gsum ste/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba kha cig gsang sngags spyir gsang bar bya ba yin pa la 'on kyang dbang gis ma smin pa'i sems can la gsang ba sgrogs pa la ltung ba med de/ ye gsang zhes bya ba'i thabs kyis chod pa'i phyir zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di yang cung zad/ ces sogs rkang pa bco lnga ste/ khyod kyi dam bca' sgrub byed dang bcas pa 'di yang cung zad brtag par bya ste/ ye gsang zhes bya ba'i don ci zhig yin/ gal te gsang sngags kyi tshig don go ba med pa la ye nas gsang ba yin zer na/ shes bya chos can/ tshig don go ba'i gang zag dbang gi ma smin pa la gsang sngags bshad na ltung bar 'gyur bar thal/ de lta bu'i gang zag de ye gsang thabs kyi chod pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi ye gsang gi don de 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ dbang gis ma smin pa'i sems can la gsang sngags bshad na gsang sgrogs kyi ltung ba med pa de min par thal lo/ /gzhan yang /

dbang gis ma smin pa'i tshig don go ba'i gang zag la gsang sngags bshad na/ slob dpon la gsang sgrogs kyi ltung ba 'byung bar rdo rje phreng ba sogs rgyud du ma las gsung pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i sde snod las kyang / blo sbyang ma byas sems can la/ /stong pa nyid ni ston pa dang / /zhes ltung bar gsung pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te kho na re skyon med de/ dam chos bden pa'i byin rlabs can gyi gsang sngags 'di gang zag su yis thos kyang phan yon che ste/ gsang sngags ni dam pa'i chos yin pas so/ /rgyu mtshan des na dbang gis smin pa dang ma smin pa'i gang zag thams cad la gsang sngags bshad na/ slob dpon la gsang sgrogs kyi ltung ba mi 'byung zer na/ shin tu mi 'thad de/ gal te khyod kyi dam pa'i chos bden pa ru ma go las che/ go na gsang sngags kyi chos nas 'byung ba bzhin du gyis te gsang sngags zab mo'i chos snod dang mi ldan pa la gsang ba dang / snod dang ldan pa la mi gsang ba'i lugs gnyis rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan des na/ smin byed kyi skabs su chos sgo zhes bya ba dang / dam tshig gi skabs su ye gsang zhes bya'i tha snyad 'di yang rdo rje'i theg pa'i bstan pa la gnod pa'i tshig yin te/ de dag rgyud 'grel khung ma gang nas kyang bshad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod na/ smin byed kyi dbang bla ma tshad ldan las rgyud sde nas ji ltar gsung pa bzhin blangs nas dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung ba la/ 'bad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa grol byed 'khrul pa med pa'i rim gnyis la bzhi ste/ lam gyi gtso bo mi dgos par 'dod pa dgag lam gyi gtso bo ngos bzung ba/ sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas de la bslab par gdam pa/ de dag dang ma 'brel ba'i chos lugs dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang /

de dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kha cig 'khrul dang / zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhi ste/ phyag rgya ba kha cig ste/ sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs lam la 'khrul pa dang / ma 'khrul pa'i dbye ba med cing / thabs lam cig tu nges pa yang med de/ rlung dang gtum mo la sogs pa'i thabs lam phyogs re bas grub pa thob pa yod pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ mtha' bral gyi lta ba rtogs pas slob dpon klu sgrub grol ba dang / slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bskyed rim gyis dang / dka' thub spyad pas slob dpon lu hi pa dang / spyod pa'i stobs kyis slob dpon nag po pa dang / rlung gi stobs kyis go rakṣa dang / gtum mo bsgom pa'i stobs kyis shā wa ri dbang phyug dang / phyag rgya chen po bsgom pas bram ze sa ra ha dang / bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis slob dpon tog rtse pa dang / za nyal 'chag gis slob dpon zhi ba'i lha dang / rgyal chen indha bhū ti btsun mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig 'dod yon la rol pa'i stobs kyis dang / rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel thams cad 'tshogs pa las slob dpon birwa pa la grub thob byung ba 'di 'dra ba'i thabs lam sna tshogs kyis sangs rgya ba la bskur ba gdab tu mi rung zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ phyogs re'i thabs kyis grol ba dgag rim gnyis thabs kyi gtso bor bstan/ gtso bo yin pa'i sgrub byed 'god/ phyogs re'i thabs kyis dgos pa bstan/ sgro bskur spangs nas gtso bor bsgrub par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di yang legs par/ zhes sogs rkang pa bdun te/ lta ba rkyang pa rtogs pas klu sgrub grol pa la sogs pa 'di yang legs par bshad kyis nyon zhes gdams nas/ ji ltar yin zhe na/ klu sgrub la sogs pa gong du bshad pa'i grub thob thams cad kyang lta ba dang bskyed rim sogs phyogs re'i thabs kyis grol ba min gyi smin byed kyi dbang dang / lam rim pa gnyis bsgom pa las byung ba'i thabs shes zung 'jug gi ye shes rgyud la skyes pas grol ba yin te/
